summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the Cleviprex (clevidipine) NDA. The Medical Review's dedicated section 8.5 'Advisory Committee Meeting' (MedR_P3, L157) is answered 'Not applicable.' (L158), and neither the Summary Review nor the Office/Division Director memo mentions an advisory committee for this application. The advisory-committee references in the Medical Review (MedR_P1, L309-L310, L360) are to historical Cardio-Renal Advisory Committee (CRAC) meetings held for OTHER IV antihypertensives (nicardipine in June 1990 and fenoldopam in June 1997), cited only as regulatory precedent for labeling/approval of IV agents, not a meeting held for clevidipine itself.
